### class `OceanOptions`

Ocean model choices (OSCAR ocean; option names).

Defaults are the standard configuration: BD-model surface box model, CO2SysPower
carbonate chemistry, MPI-ESM-LR mixed-layer response and pco2 weights 0/0/1.
v_osn_model, mod_OSNKchem, mod_OSNKtrans and the three pco2_w_* weights can all be
set from the command line.

Fields: `v_osn_model`, `mod_OSNKchem`, `mod_OSNKtrans`, `pco2_form`, `pco2_w_poly`, `pco2_w_pade`, `pco2_w_power`, `ocn_nsub`, `ocean_model`, `same_alk`, `hector_tcre_rates`

## `scm4opt.core.errors`

```text
Model errors.
```

### class `ModelBoundsError`

A model variable left its admissible range.

variable : name of the variable (e.g. "scm_atmo_pool", "hct_dic(ob_LL)")
value    : its value, if known
bound    : the violated bound or range (e.g. "[1, 1e5]", ">= 1e-3")
Subclass of FloatingPointError, so `except FloatingPointError` still catches it.


## `scm4opt.core.registry`

```text
The variable registry: one row per output, report symbol and parameter.

registry/registry.csv (in the package data: registry/registry.csv) has the columns

  name, kind (output | report | parameter), module, dims, unit, time_basis
  (state | per_step | per_year | none), description, reference,
  report_order (position in the model report, empty if not reported),
  report_group (variable | parameter: how the RCMIP export treats a reported symbol)

and is the single source of truth for:
  report_symbols()      the report symbols in report order (report.py)
  report_parameters()   the reported symbols that are parameters (zero rows dropped)
  per_step_names()      outputs/report symbols stored per model step (the RCMIP export
                        sums their steps into yearly values)
  check_registry()      unit checks: unit grammar (units.py), time basis against the unit,
                        names, report order, and every RCMIP3 export conversion
                        (output_mapping.csv scale x steps per year) against the units
  check_outputs(out)    every array of a run is registered, with matching dimensions
```

### `variables(reg=None)`

Rows of the outputs and report symbols, indexed by name (names are unique there).

### `report_symbols(reg=None)`

Report symbols in report order.

### `report_parameters(reg=None)`

### `per_step_names(reg=None)`

### `check_registry(reg=None, mapping=None, known=frozenset({'doe_heatcontent', 'doe_heatflux'}))`

Problems found in the registry: a list of strings (empty if none).

mapping : the RCMIP3 output mapping (report.load_output_mapping()); its conversions
          are checked when given (known: see check_rcmip_mapping).

### `rcmip_conversions(mapping, reg=None)`

One row per reported RCMIP3 variable: registry unit, RCMIP unit, the factor
implied by the units and the factor the export applies (scale x steps per year).

### `check_rcmip_mapping(mapping, reg=None, produced=None, known=frozenset({'doe_heatcontent', 'doe_heatflux'}))`

Problems of the RCMIP3 export conversions (see rcmip_conversions).

produced : names the report can produce; mapped variables outside it are skipped
           by the export and reported here only if registered.
known    : variables whose problems are known and not reported (KNOWN_RCMIP_ISSUES);
           pass () to see them.

### `check_outputs(out, reg=None)`

Problems of a run's outputs against the registry: unregistered arrays and
dimension mismatches (number of dimensions; dims 't,...' in the registry).

### `default_mapping()`

The RCMIP3 output mapping with the reported rows, with the export's time scaling
(report.load_output_mapping).

### `main(argv=None)`

python3 -m scm4opt.core.registry [--all]: run the registry checks and print a
summary (--all also shows the known RCMIP3 export issues). Exit code 1 on problems.

Constants: `DAT_DIR`, `KINDS`, `KNOWN_RCMIP_ISSUES`, `PACKAGE_DATA_DIR`, `RCMIP_TOLERANCE`, `REGISTRY_CSV`, `REPORT_GROUPS`, `STEPS_PER_YEAR`, `TIME_BASES`

## `scm4opt.core.units`

```text
Units of the variable registry: parsing, dimensions and conversion factors.

Grammar of a registry unit (registry/registry.csv, column unit):

  unit  := "1" | [number " "] term {" " term} {"/" term}
  term  := symbol[exponent]          e.g. m2, m3 (no negative exponents: write W/m2/K)
  mass terms may be followed by one species: "Mt CO2", "kt HFC23", "Mt N", "GtC"

  e.g.  ppm  ppb  ppt  K  W/m2  W/m2/K  GtC/step  Mt CO2/yr  kt CFC11/step  Mt N/step
        1/yr  yr  umol/kg  uatm  kg/m3  1e22 J  ZJ/yr  DU  %  1

parse(unit) returns a Quantity (factor to base units, dimensions, species);
factor(a, b) is the number that converts a value in unit a into unit b. Species
conversions go through a shared element (GtC -> Mt CO2, Mt N -> Mt N2O, Mt S -> Mt SO2).
A model step is 1/6 year, so "GtC/step" -> "GtC/yr" is a factor of 6.
```

### class `Quantity`

## `scm4opt.core.version`

```text
Version of the Python SCM4OPT and the names it writes into its outputs.

__version__          package version (the exported package's __version__ and pyproject.toml)
RCMIP_CLIMATE_MODEL  climate_model of the RCMIP3 submission rows of this implementation;
                     the original SCM4OPT submits as "SCM4OPTv4.0". The submission's model
                     metadata and comments files must carry the same name (rcmip validate:
                     "climate_model not consistent across the bundle").
RCMIP_FILE_PREFIX    file-name prefix of the RCMIP3 files (member and ensemble files), kept
                     as in the original SCM4OPT so that the export, the runners'
                     --skip-done and the analysis scripts find the files of both
```

### `version_line()`

One line for logs: package version and the RCMIP3 model name.

Constants: `RCMIP_CLIMATE_MODEL`, `RCMIP_FILE_PREFIX`
